description: Dead Cells is a roguelite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.
name: Dead Cells

objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
objectives.versus_tertiary: Most health flask chargest at end of run

entries.text: Beat the game with all stats evenly distrubuted
Using Custom Mode, disable the Minor Forge
Kill the Hand of the King with a parry
Keep at least 1 item of each colour in your inventory
